worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.summary: Spit unmatched tongues of flame, one after another: each advances from the mouth and is cut off by walls, burning, igniting and shoving several enemies along the way; only ground actually touched is left with thin, short embers. Re-aim between tongues. Afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.0: Sweep several enemies on one line with a flame tongue and set them alight
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.1: Leave a lasting burning patch across a chokepoint
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.2: Burn a close opponent away and force it off its spot
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.description: Spits %2$s tongues of flame along the current aim, each dealing about %1$s fire damage to every enemy in the beam; the direction is fixed within a tongue and can change between them, and walls cut a tongue short.
Each tongue first steps in up to %2$s blocks, then reaches up to %1$s blocks with a %4$s block radius (half-width); tongues are %3$s apart, and a hit shoves people %5$s blocks outward.

The supporting ground the tongue actually sweeps over is left with embers up to %1$s blocks across, lasting %2$s; enemies standing in them are repeatedly set alight, and anyone caught by the tongue or stepping into the embers is set alight for %3$s.

Afterwards the user reels in confusion for %1$s: each attempted action has a %2$s chance to be disrupted; a disrupted attempt takes a little spark-backlash damage, but the backlash does not extend the daze.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.inferno.on: Inferno form: the smoldering patch is larger, lasts longer and ignites longer with slightly lower damage per burst, but the charge is shorter with a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.inferno.off: Stampede form: charges further, keeps a faster rhythm and loses control for less time, but the patch left behind is smaller and shorter.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.growth.0: From level %1$s each burst rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.growth.1: From level %1$s each burst rises to %2$s and the smoldering radius to %3$s blocks.
On: the smoldering patch is larger and lasts longer and ignites longer, but the charge is shorter with a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze - for holding chokepoints. Off (stampede): charges further, keeps a faster rhythm and loses control for less time, but the patch left behind is smaller and shorter.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: below a third health the target is prioritized. Off: the move keeps its normal priority (the default, as it is more about laying fire).
